evals.prompt: Review a 6-axis FreeCAD robot arm carrying a 5 kg payload at 800 mm reach. The designer selected motors from static gravity torque and says the native motion animation proves it is production ready. Produce a gated engineering review and identify the evidence needed for release.
evals.expected_output: Rejects animation/static sizing as sufficient; covers trajectory load histories, peak/RMS torque, reflected inertia, gearbox/bearing life, thermal duty, singularities, workspace, accuracy, stopping, cables, risk and physical tests.
assertions: Separates kinematic animation from dynamic, thermal, life and safety evidence.
Requires peak and RMS torque-speed checks from credible trajectories.
Requires workspace/singularity, braking/power-loss and physical acceptance evidence.

evals.prompt: Design the engineering contract for a belt-driven pan-tilt camera head that must hold position during power loss, achieve 0.05 degree repeatability, survive one million reversals, export to ROS 2, and route power/data through both axes.
evals.expected_output: Produces a configuration-controlled mechanism contract including belts/bearings, reflected inertia, backlash/compliance, thermal and life evidence, brake behavior, cable torsion/cycle life, calibration and URDF/ROS frame/inertia checks.
assertions: Defines stable link/joint/frame architecture and ROS/URDF reconciliation.
Closes repeatability through an error budget and calibration plan.
Addresses belt/bearing life, cable cycle life and power-loss holding.

evals.prompt: Our vertical ballscrew robot axis is fast enough nominally, but it can descend under gravity if the drive trips. Review motor, screw, support bearings and brake sizing for a 24/7 production cell and give a verification matrix.
evals.expected_output: Checks trajectory loads, critical speed/buckling, bearing and screw duty life, motor RMS/thermal performance, regenerated energy, brake build time/energy/wear, gravity-drop fault response and configuration-specific testing without claiming certification.
assertions: Covers ballscrew critical speed/buckling and bearing/transmission duty life.
Checks motor RMS/peak/thermal and regenerative energy.
Defines brake and gravity-drop fault tests without claiming certification.
